title: Lieb–Robinson Bounds for Nonrelativistic Fermions
exact_target: Extend the local effective-dynamics error estimate from pseudo-relativistic to nonrelativistic high-density fermions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006188 (OWR-14299085-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: New Directions in Correlated Quantum Systems (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/7, pp. 339--374. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The constant $C(t)$ must retain the report's uniformity in the scaling parameter and admissible observables. Unbounded one-particle speed is the obstruction being investigated.
